title: mail-server memory: email_history follows the memory object-history capability; objectHistory end to end in EmailPush
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E16. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: S.

Follow-up once object-history lands Email history in the memory backend (docs/design/object-history.md H5). Spec: object-history-03 §3.1; draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §3 prefix rule, §4. Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §6, §7, §9 (object-history); decision 10 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

Make the memory EmailPushBackend set EmailPushAccount.email_history from its ObjectHistoryBackend::object_history_capability (true exactly when supported_types contains "Email") instead of the fixed false.
Acceptance: with the memory backend registered via register_mail_handlers_with_history, a PushSubscription/set with properties ["from","objectHistory","subject"] is accepted, stored and echoed as ["from","subject"], and deliver_email pushes Emails whose keys are a prefix of ["from","subject"] with no objectHistory; with history not offered for Email the same set => invalidProperties ["emailPush","emailPush/A/properties"].
